name: queep-3-arena
description: Quake III Arena / OpenArena gameplay ported to the meep engine (WebGPU/ECS).

scripts.setup: node tools/fetch-sources.mjs && node tools/fetch-assets.mjs && node tools/extract-pk3.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node tools/trap-matrix.mjs --check && node tools/extract-balance.mjs --check && node tools/material-matrix.ts --check && npm test
scripts.assets: node tools/convert-models.ts && node tools/convert-characters.ts && node tools/convert-sounds.ts
